reading: This sketch is a Kanban-style task board with a top filter/search bar, four column headers (To do / In progress / Review / Done with counts), and two swimlanes ('WEB APP' and 'MOBILE') each containing a dashed section divider, a capitalized label, and a column of task cards with tags, titles, avatars and progress bars as described by the typed notes.
